reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`) have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: deprecation

consequence.statement: The flags still work in 1.17 but will be removed in Cilium 1.18, so usage must move to the Cilium CLI for sysdump collection.
consequence.remediation: Use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

proposed.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and related --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label) is deprecated and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.
